{{Top|leg}}
The '''722nd''', also known as '''"Copperheads"''' were a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] Starfighter Corps. [[Flight Captain]] [[Myrette Davani]], the [[Flight leader/Legends|Flight Leader]] of the 1/181st [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] within the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]], and the first publicly announced [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], had formerly served under the 722nd for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[Time/Legends|prior]] to joining the elite TIE Fighter wing.
